subject: Control System
questionText:
Regarding the system consider the statements 
 
1. 
Open-loop system is stable 
 
2. 
Closed-loop system is unstable 
 
3. 
One closed-loop poles is lying on the RHP 
 
The correct statements are  
 
(a) 1 and 2 
 
(b) 1 and 3 
 
(c) only 2 
 
(d) All
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-20 (Nyquist Plot - II).
